[h3][b]How can I transfer my account?[/b][/h3]
[b]Step-by-Step Instruction[/b]

[b]Don't add Wolfteam: Reboot on your Steam library before you submit the transfer form.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/8c12310a836382e6dac3c30a78f2f21a8b240500.png[/img]

1. Click the <Steam> button and log in with your Steam ID

2. Fill in the transfer token number that AeriaGames(Gamigo) gave

3. Write down Callsign(Nickname) you want

4. Click the <Submit> button

[b]※ Please be aware if you make an account on steam before you submit the transfer request form, you will lose your account.[/b]


[b]This message will pop up [/b]

1. When the Callsign you put already has been taken

2. If your Steam account already has a linked game account

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/5f666bc26ef35420488d6d16f873c3d4bec669bc.png[/img]


If you have any problems after transferring your game account, please send an email to us: [u]cs@neosonyx.com[/u]

- [b]your Steam ID[/b]
You can find your Steam ID on the [Steam] main page > Click your profile above the page > Click Account details.
